description: This Java class provides the configuration activity for an Android app widget, allowing users to set a prefix text which is stored in SharedPreferences and used to update the widget.

classes.name: ExampleAppWidgetConfigure
classes.description: An activity providing a configuration interface for an Android app widget, allowing the user to specify a prefix string stored in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the widget ID from the intent, sets up the view, and preloads the prefix text.

methods.name: mOnClickListener
methods.description: Handles the save button click, saving the entered prefix, updating the widget, and finishing the activity.

methods.name: saveTitlePref
methods.description: Stores the specified prefix string in SharedPreferences for the given widget ID.

methods.name: loadTitlePref
methods.description: Retrieves the stored prefix string from SharedPreferences for a specific widget ID, falling back to a default resource string if not present.

methods.name: deleteTitlePref
methods.description: Placeholder for method to delete preferences for a widget (not implemented).

methods.name: loadAllTitlePrefs
methods.description: Placeholder for method to load all widget prefixes (not implemented).
